# ABCI V1 interoperability fixtures

`v1-vectors.json` is the byte-identical schema-4 file from
`taikoxyz/taiko-mono` commit `23963b68e43b4cbeaf83113eeb61fbc1bddb4c46`, path
`testdata/etna_vectors/vectors.json` (SHA-256 `580dfd505ee07cff429e030bb712a6463e0e974f97363ab2947d89427edd2183`).
It is isolated here while Task 3 regenerates the shared lander/deployment artifacts; do not
change protocol vector contents by hand. The tests exercise native keys, domains/votes,
committee hashes, storage layout and all 62 FI eligibility vectors.

`comet-wire.json` is generated by `comet-wire-oracle`, pinned to unmodified stock CometBFT
v0.40.0 and Go 1.27.2. The oracle emits InitChain with native key tag 5, application version 1,
initial height 1 and the first schema-4 generation-zero domain; it also emits FinalizeBlock
validator updates and the native validator-set hash. These are transport fixtures, not a
recovery implementation. Its transport mechanics originated from reference `4c71bd0a1`;
no V15 consensus format or fee/recovery path is used.

Regenerate twice and compare before replacing the committed file:

```sh
cd comet-wire-oracle
GOCACHE=/tmp/etna-comet-wire-cache go run . > /tmp/comet-wire-a.json
GOCACHE=/tmp/etna-comet-wire-cache go run . > /tmp/comet-wire-b.json
cmp /tmp/comet-wire-a.json /tmp/comet-wire-b.json
cp /tmp/comet-wire-a.json ../comet-wire.json
```

The Task 1 regeneration ran twice with identical output. Existing signing files and real keys
are never inputs to this oracle; its three private scalars are fixed public test fixtures.
